name: settings-default
description: A settings panel with master volume, reverb, tempo and haptics. Clean shadcn-style look.
author: Spatial

name: settings-glass
description: The same settings, on a frosted glass panel that floats over your scene.
author: Spatial

name: settings-horizon
description: The same settings in a Quest-native Horizon style.
author: Spatial
Spatial
name: press-button
description: A physical button that sinks 6 mm when you poke it and springs back. Fires onPress.

author: Spatial
name: glow-button
description: A 16 cm button that glows brighter as your fingertip approaches, sinks when pressed and flashes on click.

author: Spatial
name: glass-button
description: A frosted-glass slab over a glowing core that lifts toward your finger and squashes when pressed.

author: Spatial
name: neon-button
description: A dark button with a neon-tube outline that breathes at rest, burns steady on hover and flares on press.

author: Spatial
name: ripple-button
description: A button that sends rings rippling out from the exact point you touch it.

author: Spatial
name: magnetic-button
description: A button that leans, slides and lifts toward your fingertip or ray, then springs back when you leave.

author: Spatial
name: holo-button
description: A floating hologram button whose iridescent shimmer shifts as you move your head.

author: Spatial
name: icon-button
description: A 6.4 cm round key showing any of 29 lucide icons, with a ring that lights as you approach.

author: Spatial
name: slider
description: A 20 cm slider you drag with a fingertip, ray or mouse. Controlled via value/onChange.

name: knob
description: Grab and twist (reused for music later)
author: Spatial
Spatial
name: spring-toggle
description: A toggle whose thumb snaps across with a bouncy spring. Tap to flip.

author: Spatial
name: checkbox
description: A 3D checkbox (or radio dot) with a label; tap either to toggle and the check springs in.

author: Spatial
name: tabs
description: Segmented tabs whose mint pill springs to the tab you poke, pinch or click.

author: Spatial
name: stepper
description: A minus / value / plus control with pokeable 3D keys and a number that pops on change.

author: Spatial
name: glass-card
description: A frosted glass backplate that groups a section of UI.

author: Spatial
name: flip-card
description: A 6 mm thick card that flips over with a little lift when you poke, pinch or click it.

props.name: backText
props.default: Detuned saws through a slow filter sweep. Sits best under a four-on-the-floor kick.

author: Spatial
name: tooltip
description: Label bubble that springs up above its anchor on hover, or pins open on a press for hands.

props.name: text
props.default: Pinch to grab, twist to rotate

author: Spatial
name: toast
description: Toast that pops up, counts down along its edge and dismisses itself (pointing at it pauses the timer).

author: Spatial
name: progress-ring
description: Glossy 3D ring that sweeps clockwise to the value, with a live percentage inside.

author: Spatial
name: dialog
description: Confirm or cancel dialog that springs in, with a warm confirm button for destructive actions.

props.name: message
props.default: “Drums 2” and its 12 clips will be removed. You can't undo this.

author: Spatial
name: window
description: Floating window with a title bar, close button, scrolling content area and a halo that glows on hover.

author: Spatial
name: wrist-menu
description: Compact vertical menu with a clock header, sized to sit on your wrist.

props.name: items
props.default: Home, Recenter, Mute mic, Settings, Exit

author: Spatial
name: radial-menu
description: Press or pinch the hub and options spring out on a ring around it.

name: billboard
description: Always faces you (wrapper)
author: Spatial

name: lazy-follow
description: Drifts after you (wrapper)
author: Spatial
Spatial
name: hold-to-confirm
description: An 8 cm disc you press and hold while a ring fills, so important actions only fire on purpose.

name: particle-burst
description: Sparks on press (wrapper)
author: Spatial
Spatial
name: model-viewer
description: Turntable for any GLB: grab and drag to spin it, let go and it coasts.

author: Spatial
name: dock
description: Shelf of app icons that swell toward you under the pointer and bounce when picked.

author: Spatial
name: number-pad
description: A 12-key 3D keypad with a display for typing codes or PINs; check submits.

author: Spatial
name: color-picker
description: A hue wheel and lightness bar you drag on, with a glowing orb that previews the colour as hex.

author: Spatial
name: xy-pad
description: 20 cm touch surface: drag the glowing puck to set two values at once. Great on a filter cutoff.

author: Spatial
name: select
description: A dropdown whose option list springs open and floats in front of the scene; tap a row to choose.

author: Spatial
name: range-slider
description: A 24 cm two-thumb slider for picking a low and high value; thumbs lift toward you while dragged.

author: Spatial
name: badge
description: Notification count floating in front of an icon tile, popping whenever the count changes.

author: Spatial
name: spinner-3d
description: Loading spinner of two arcs tumbling in a gyroscope around a breathing core.

author: Spatial
name: bar-chart-3d
description: Solid 3D bars that grow in and reveal their value when you hover a column.

author: Spatial
name: gauge
description: Dial with a springy needle and a tick ring that lights up to a 0-1 value.

author: Spatial
name: stat-card
description: KPI card on a thick slab with a trend arrow; hover lifts it and shows the comparison.

author: Spatial
name: sparkline
description: Trend card whose 3D line draws itself in; hover along it to read any point.

author: Spatial
name: timeline-scrubber
description: Drag the thumb or tap the rail to scrub; hover previews the time under your finger.

author: Spatial
name: video-panel
description: Floating video screen that plays and pauses on press, with a tap-to-seek bar.

author: Spatial
name: curved-gallery
description: Images on an arc that wraps toward you; hover to lift one, press to pull it close.

author: Spatial
name: audio-player
description: Music card with a spinning 3D record and tonearm, play/pause and a draggable seek bar.

author: Spatial
name: label
description: 3D title text for naming a section of your scene.

author: Spatial
name: transport
description: Play/stop for the global Tone transport, sets the BPM

author: Spatial
name: drum-pad
description: Hit it to play a kick, snare, hat or clap

author: Spatial
name: step-sequencer
description: 16 steps × 4 drums, plays on the transport

author: Spatial
name: tempo-display
description: Big BPM readout

author: Spatial
name: vu-meter
description: Live level of the master output

author: Spatial
name: piano-keys
description: One octave of pokeable keys

author: Spatial
name: fader
description: 21 cm vertical fader with a real 3D cap: grab and slide, or tap the track to jump. Glows while you drag.

author: Spatial
name: env-studio-loft
description: Warm indoor loft with an oak floor, brick wall, tall steel windows and soft daylight.

author: Spatial
name: env-space
description: Deep space with a star field, a ringed gas giant, nebula glow and a floating hex platform under you.

author: Spatial
name: env-forest
description: Outdoor clearing ringed by stylised low-poly trees under a gradient sky with light fog.

author: Spatial
name: env-concert-stage
description: Dark concert stage with truss, sweeping colored beams, an LED wall, a glossy floor and an audience glow.

author: Spatial
name: env-gallery
description: Minimal white gallery with soft even light, framed abstract works and plinths with turning sculptures.

author: Spatial
name: frame
description: Auto-layout container: lines its children up in a row, column, grid or a curved wall around you.

author: Spatial
name: lamp
description: A 40 cm table lamp that switches a real point light on and off when you press it.

author: Spatial
name: tv
description: A 43-inch TV on a stand that plays or pauses a muted video when you press the screen.

author: Spatial
name: speaker
description: A bookshelf speaker that plays a looping chord groove when you press it, its woofer pumping to the beat.

author: Spatial
name: globe
description: A desk globe with a dot-matrix world map that turns slowly and spins faster when you drag or flick it.

author: Spatial
name: door
description: A 2 m door that swings open or shut on a spring when you press it, with warm light spilling through.

author: Spatial
name: clock
description: A 30 cm analog wall clock that shows the live local time with a sweeping second hand.

author: Spatial
name: whiteboard
description: A 1 m whiteboard you draw on with a fingertip, pinch or mouse, with marker colours and an eraser that clears it.

author: Spatial
name: plant
description: A 50 cm potted plant whose leaves sway gently.

author: Spatial
name: desk
description: A modern 120 x 60 cm work desk with a solid top on a slim steel frame.

author: Spatial
name: chair
description: A mid-century chair with an upholstered seat and back on splayed oak legs.

author: Spatial
name: mixer-strip
description: Channel strip: 3D fader, pan knob, mute button and a post-fader level meter. Wire it to a synth or loop player.

author: Spatial
name: waveform
description: Live oscilloscope of everything going to the speakers, drawn as a glowing line that holds still on steady notes.

author: Spatial
name: loop-player
description: 8 clip pads (drums, bass, pad, arp, lead) that loop in sync with the transport. Tap to launch on the next bar.

author: Spatial
name: synth
description: Playable mono synth: 8 note pads with glide and a resonant lowpass filter you sweep with the cutoff dial.

author: Spatial
name: coin-pickup
description: A spinning gold coin you collect by touching it: it zips up, sparkles, dings and respawns, counting as it goes.

author: Spatial
name: dice
description: A six-sided die you press to roll: it tosses, tumbles, bounces with a clack and settles on a random face.

author: Spatial
name: treasure-chest
description: A wooden chest that flings its lid open on tap, with glowing gold, a rising light beam and drifting motes.

author: Spatial
name: confetti-burst
description: A party popper that fires up to 300 fluttering confetti pieces with a pop when tapped or when its trigger changes.

author: Spatial
name: basketball-hoop
description: A mini hoop with a ball you tap to shoot: it arcs to the rim for a swish, sparks and a point, or clangs off.

author: Spatial
name: health-bar
description: A 30 cm glass health bar whose fill springs to the value, with a lagging damage ghost, a heal shimmer and a red low-health pulse; tap it for demo damage.

author: Spatial
name: score-counter
description: A score panel whose number rolls up on a spring, pops and floats "+N"; tap to add points with a coin blip that climbs in pitch on fast taps.

author: Spatial
name: cooldown-ring
description: A 10 cm round ability button with a clockwise cooldown sweep: tap to cast, taps while cooling are denied, and it flashes and pings when ready.

author: Spatial
name: countdown-timer
description: A countdown panel with a draining progress bar and play/pause and reset buttons that beeps through the last five seconds and alarms at zero.

author: Spatial
name: achievement-popup
description: An achievement toast that springs up with a trophy, a shine sweep and a three-note fanfare, then auto-hides to a small replay chip.

author: Spatial
name: inventory-grid
description: Fingertip-sized inventory slots with game item icons; tap one to equip it with a spring pop, mint glow ring and a metallic shing.

author: Spatial
name: quest-tracker
description: Quest card with tappable objectives that pop a check and strike through; finishing all of them flashes warm, chimes and bursts sparks.

author: Spatial
name: dialogue-box
description: RPG dialogue panel that types lines out with voice blips; tap to skip or advance, then pick from springy choice buttons.

props.name: lines
default: Halt, traveller! The old bridge is out.
They say a slime guards the chest past the falls.
Will you help me find the key?

author: Spatial
name: item-wheel
description: Weapon and item wheel whose segments lean out as a finger nears; tap one to equip it with a mint glow and a click.

author: Spatial
name: target-reticle
description: 20 cm crosshair target that locks on when aimed at (ticks snap in, mint turns warm) and fires a shock ring with a hit counter on tap.

author: Spatial
name: minimap
description: 25 cm circular radar whose sweep lights up drifting enemy blips; tap anywhere to send a sonar ping from that spot.

author: Spatial
name: lever-switch
description: 25 cm wall lever you grab and pull down (or tap) to switch on; it slams home with a heavy clunk and lights its lamp.

author: Spatial
name: pressure-plate
description: 30 cm floor plate that sinks with a thunk when pressed, glowing at the rim and rolling light rings across the floor.

author: Spatial
name: xylophone
description: 37 cm one-octave xylophone (C5 to C6): poke or click a bar to play it, with a wobble and a puff of note-coloured sparks.

author: Spatial
name: sidebar-nav
description: App sidebar with a workspace header, icon nav items with badges, a springy active highlight and a signed-in user footer.

author: Spatial
name: command-palette
description: Search field with a grouped command list that filters as you type; tap a row to run it.

author: Spatial
name: file-browser
description: Drill-down file browser with typed file icons: tap folders to open them, back to go up, tap a file to select it.

author: Spatial
name: calendar
description: Month calendar with event dots, Today and month paging, and the selected day's agenda underneath.

author: Spatial
name: kanban-board
description: Three-column kanban board with tagged, assigned cards; tap a card to move it to the next column.

author: Spatial
name: chat-panel
description: Chat panel with a presence header, message bubbles, one-tap quick replies and a message field with send.

author: Spatial
name: notification-center
description: Notification list with typed icons and unread dots; tap to mark read, X to dismiss, Clear all to empty it.

author: Spatial
name: login-form
description: Sign-in form with email and password fields, show/hide password, loading and success states, and a passkey option.

author: Spatial
name: profile-card
description: Profile card with cover, avatar and presence dot, bio, stats and Follow / Message buttons.

props.name: bio
props.default: Designs spatial tools for people who build in 3D.

author: Spatial
name: data-table
description: Sortable data table with status chips and a total row; tap a header to sort and a row to select it.

author: Spatial
name: tree-view
description: Expandable tree with indent guides and a springy chevron; tap a branch to open it and any node to select it.

author: Spatial
name: breadcrumbs
description: Breadcrumb bar: tap a crumb to go back to it, and the crumbs you left stay faint so you can step forward again.

author: Spatial
name: pagination
description: Page picker with prev / next, numbered pages with gaps, and a Page X of Y caption.

author: Spatial
name: avatar-group
description: Overlapping presence avatars that lift on hover to show a name; tap +N to fan out everyone.

author: Spatial
name: toolbar
description: Floating tool bar: pick one tool and the highlight springs across, plus undo / redo; horizontal or vertical.

author: Spatial
name: context-menu
description: Context menu with icons, shortcuts, dividers, a disabled item and a destructive Delete; pops open from its corner.

author: Spatial
name: activity-timeline
description: Vertical activity feed with typed icons on a connecting rail; entries cascade in and tap to select.

author: Spatial
name: search-bar
description: Search field with clear and mic buttons, a focus ring, a listening pulse and one-tap recent searches.

author: Spatial
name: weather-widget
description: Weather card with big temperature, conditions, wind / humidity / UV, a C/F switch and a tappable hourly strip.

author: Spatial
name: music-now-playing
description: Now-playing card with cover art and a live equalizer, like button, progress and shuffle / skip / play / repeat controls.

author: Spatial
name: todo-list
description: To-do list with springy checkboxes, a progress bar and a field to add tasks.

author: Spatial
name: clock-widget
description: Digital clock with steady digits, a blinking colon, the date and tappable world clocks; tap the time to switch 12/24 h.

author: Spatial
name: mascot
description: Pix, a 13 cm voxel critter for your AI assistant. It hovers, blinks and looks at you, perks its ears when listening, orbits dots when thinking, chatters when talking, hops with confetti when happy, and giggles when poked.

author: Spatial
name: gltf-model
description: Any .glb/.gltf model as an editable object: centred, auto-sized, and a surface you can build components onto.

author: Spatial
name: hardware-synth
description: A desktop polysynth: poke its 13 keys to play, and its cutoff, attack, release and volume knobs really shape the sound on an OLED readout.

author: Spatial
name: drum-machine
description: An MPC-style drum machine: 16 light-up pads play kick, snare, hat and clap, and PLAY runs a built-in beat on the shared transport.

author: Spatial
name: studio-monitors
description: A pair of 5-inch studio monitors whose woofers really pump with whatever is playing; tap the power LED to mute the room.

author: Spatial
name: mixing-console
description: An 8-channel mixer with draggable faders, mute buttons and scribble strips; the red MAIN fader sets the real master volume, with a live stereo meter.

author: Spatial
name: turntable
description: A direct-drive turntable: press START and the platter spins up, the tonearm swings in and a lo-fi groove plays on the shared transport.

author: Spatial
name: audio-interface
description: A 2-input USB audio interface whose gain halos light from the live level, and whose MONITOR knob really sets the speaker volume.

author: Spatial
name: computer-monitor
description: A 27-inch display running a live DAW arrangement whose playhead follows the shared transport; tap the power LED to switch it off.

author: Spatial
name: headphones-stand
description: A desk stand with a pair of closed-back studio headphones resting on it.

author: Spatial
name: sofa
description: A two-metre fabric sofa with loose seat and back cushions on tapered wooden legs.

author: Spatial
name: bookshelf
description: A 1.8 m wooden bookcase with five shelves of books; its top is a placement surface.

author: Spatial
name: side-table
description: A round oak side table on three splayed legs; its top is a placement surface.

author: Spatial
name: rug
description: A 2 x 1.4 m wool rug with a procedural persian, geometric or striped weave.

author: Spatial
name: acoustic-panels
description: A wall set of wedge-foam acoustic tiles in a two-colour checkerboard.

author: Spatial
name: neon-sign
description: A neon sign with your text that flickers to life, hums and casts coloured light; tap to switch it on or off.

author: Spatial
name: wall-window
description: A wall window with a deep reveal, a day, sunset or night sky and light spilling into the room; tap it to roll the blind.

author: Spatial
name: floor-lamp
description: A 1.6 m brass floor lamp with a linen shade; tap the shade or pull the chain to switch a real light on or off.

author: Spatial
name: wall-art
description: A framed 60 x 80 cm print of a procedural landscape in one of five palettes; change the seed for a new composition.

author: Spatial
name: kinetic-title
description: A big extruded 3D headline whose letters flip up one by one with a trailing echo, then breathe and lift toward your pointer.

author: Spatial
name: particle-field
description: A spiral galaxy of up to 3,000 glowing particles that swirls toward your pointer or fingertip and bursts when tapped.

author: Spatial
name: morph-blob
description: A glossy noise-displaced blob that morphs on its own and ripples out from wherever you poke it.

author: Spatial
name: gradient-orb
description: A glowing aurora orb with flowing gradient bands, a soft halo and orbit rings that pulses on hover and sends a shockwave on tap.

author: Spatial
name: portal-ring
description: A rotating neon ring around a swirling tunnel with gyroscope rings and sparks; tap it to flash open and switch scenes with onPress.

author: Spatial
name: marquee-ring
description: Text looping around two tilted rings that spin in opposite directions around a glowing core; hover speeds it up, tap reverses it.

author: Spatial
name: floating-cards
description: A fan of 3 to 7 glossy cards that drift with parallax; tap one and it springs forward with its 3D icon (pass `items` with title, subtitle and color).

author: Spatial
name: typewriter-panel
description: A glass panel that types its text with a blinking caret, pauses on punctuation, then erases and loops without the layout ever jumping.

bindable.default: Hey, I'm Nova. Drop a knob next to the drum pads and I'll wire it to the tempo for you.

props.name: text
props.default: Hey, I'm Nova. Drop a knob next to the drum pads and I'll wire it to the tempo for you.

author: Spatial
name: aurora-ribbon
description: Three twisting ribbons of streaked aurora light that ripple where you hover and carry a surge of light when tapped.

author: Spatial
name: reveal-card
description: A card that unfolds toward you with a spring when it enters view, traces its glowing border and fades its text in line by line; tap to replay.

props.name: body
props.default: Cards that unfold into place the moment they enter your view. Tap to replay the reveal.

author: Spatial
name: liquid-button
description: A glossy liquid pill button whose surface squashes and ripples out from your fingertip on press, then jiggles back.

author: Spatial
name: spotlight-text
description: A dark wall of text lit by a moving spotlight cone that wanders on its own and follows your pointer or fingertip.

author: Spatial
name: env-light-studio
description: Bright, seamless photo-studio backdrop: a soft grey floor fading into an off-white wall. Calm, so your components carry the colour.

author: Spatial
name: env-meadow
description: Sunny, flat meadow under a clear midday sky. A real photo projected onto level ground, so components stand flat.

author: Spatial
name: env-beach
description: Wide, flat sand beach on a clear morning, sea on the horizon. A real photo projected onto level ground.

author: Spatial
name: env-open-lot
description: Empty, flat open lot under a big cloudy sky: lots of room to build. A real photo projected onto level ground.

author: Spatial
name: env-desert
description: Flat desert floor ringed by rocky hills, under a deep blue sky. A real photo projected onto level ground.

author: Spatial
name: env-night-field
description: Flat field at night: starry sky and town glow on the horizon. A real photo projected onto level ground.
